sourcePlanSnapshot.templateYaml:
schemaVersion: 1.0.0
templateId: template_composite_demo
revisionId: revision_demo_v1
names:
  en: Synthetic alternating pyramid
  cs: Syntetická střídavá pyramida
description:
  en: Synthetic nonclinical test; alternates individual repetitions from two exercise sets.
sections:
  - sectionId: section_strength
    names: {en: Strength, cs: Posilování}
    blocks:
      - blockId: block_alternating
        names: {en: Alternating block, cs: Střídavý blok}
        kind: composite
        occurrences:
          - occurrenceId: occurrence_hip_lift
            exerciseId: exercise_bridge_band
            sets:
              - setId: set_hip_yellow
                variationId: hip_lift_level_1
                repetitions: 1
                side: bilateral
                resistance:
                  bands:
                    - {equipmentId: band_yellow, count: 1, placement: knees}
                phases:
                  - {phaseId: phase_prepare_hip, name: prepare, mode: timed, durationMs: 4000}
                  - {phaseId: phase_hold_hip, name: hold, mode: timed, durationMs: 8000}
              - setId: set_hip_red
                variationId: hip_lift_level_2
                repetitions: 1
                side: bilateral
                resistance:
                  bands:
                    - {equipmentId: band_red, count: 2, placement: knees}
                phases:
                  - {phaseId: phase_prepare_hip_red, name: prepare, mode: timed, durationMs: 4000}
                  - {phaseId: phase_hold_hip_red, name: hold, mode: timed, durationMs: 8000}
          - occurrenceId: occurrence_plank
            exerciseId: exercise_plank
            sets:
              - setId: set_plank_red
                variationId: plank_level_1
                repetitions: 2
                side: bilateral
                resistance:
                  bands:
                    - {equipmentId: band_red, count: 1, placement: hands}
                phases:
                  - {phaseId: phase_prepare_plank, name: prepare, mode: timed, durationMs: 2000}
                  - {phaseId: phase_hold_plank, name: hold, mode: timed, durationMs: 6000}
        order:
          - {stepId: step_hip_1, kind: repetition, setId: set_hip_yellow, repetitionIndex: 1}
          - {stepId: step_plank_1, kind: repetition, setId: set_plank_red, repetitionIndex: 1}
          - {stepId: step_hip_2, kind: repetition, setId: set_hip_red, repetitionIndex: 1}
          - {stepId: step_rest_1, kind: rest, durationMs: 10000, label: {en: Transition rest}}
          - {stepId: step_plank_2, kind: repetition, setId: set_plank_red, repetitionIndex: 2}
exerciseYamls:
schemaVersion: 1.0.0
familyId: exercise_bridge_band
names:
  en: Quadruped hip lift
  cs: Kyčlozdvih na všech čtyřech
shortNames:
  en: Hip lift
  cs: Kyčlozdvih
description:
  en: Synthetic training example used only for automated testing.
tags: [strength, mobility]
equipmentIds: [band_yellow, band_red]
variations:
  - variationId: hip_lift_level_1
    names: {en: Hip lift L1, cs: Kyčlozdvih L1}
    instructions:
      en: Synthetic test instructions; not physiotherapy advice.
  - variationId: hip_lift_level_2
    names: {en: Hip lift L2, cs: Kyčlozdvih L2}
    instructions:
      en: Different range of motion for synthetic testing.
schemaVersion: 1.0.0
familyId: exercise_plank
names: {en: Controlled plank, cs: Prkno s kontrolou}
shortNames: {en: Plank, cs: Prkno}
variations:
  - variationId: plank_level_1
    names: {en: Plank L1, cs: Prkno L1}
    instructions: {en: Synthetic example; not medical instructions.}
